checks.title: Goal Owner
checks.instructions: Agree on the customer outcome and source, decision and action owners. Produce an observed launch register and a sourced funnel review with coverage, stage counts, gaps and owner action.

checks.title: Subject Scope
checks.instructions: Bind exact tenant and subject IDs. One approved offer, launch, campaign, time window and attribution model; no inferred qualified lead or revenue lift.

checks.title: Source Policy
checks.instructions: Agree on data access, version and source-of-truth policy. Read provider publication evidence, campaign and form events, current CRM lead and opportunity records, identity rule and lookback window.

checks.title: Decision Rule
checks.instructions: Record the blocking decision rule and evidence gaps. Stage counts must reconcile in order and unmatched events retain partial attribution; contact and sales acceptance remain separate.

checks.title: Team Bindings
checks.instructions: Inspect the named Crew templates and existing compatible Crews. Record exact Crew IDs, skill versions and grants; propose creation only for a missing owner or access boundary.

checks.title: Source Access
checks.instructions: Read at least one real authorized first-stage record and the current downstream source. Record source IDs, observed times, permissions, missing fields and owner.

checks.title: Handoff Contract
checks.instructions: Run scripts/validate_handoff.py on each stage artifact. Block wrong tenant, subject, source revision, producer, approval or route-specific claim. The typed sequence is launch-signal-register/v1 → gtm-funnel-reconciliation/v1.

checks.title: Plan Review
checks.instructions: Show the concrete Crew bindings, artifact paths, validator steps, manual route, approvals, deduplication, cost and notifications. No campaign spend, CRM stage edit, lead contact or revenue claim follows from a form event or this Playbook installation.

checks.title: Test Run
checks.instructions: Run one authorized campaign with a duplicate event and unmatched lead; check source IDs and owner corrections manually. Save real source references, artifacts, validation and owner corrections. Fictional examples cannot complete this check.

checks.title: Activation Choice
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. Any event or schedule needs exact subject and deduplication keys, permissions, retry limits, cost and notification review. Keep all consequential actions behind separate approval and provider receipts.
